items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Well, I used to get jobs and I used to hire him.

ctx.x: Did you play much with the D? Not regular, but now I'm dead, you know, somebody hiring them. Play with them. How about Happy Landings? Did you ever work there? Happy Landings? Yeah, I worked there with Joe G. Parker. He was playing in that for a good while with us. I don't know anything about him much, you know. Did he? No, Joe G. Parker. Oh. He must have been an awful good piano player. I just didn't know him. He was playing in that for a good time. He was playing in that for a good time. I wish somebody had…
Did you ever play with Ernie Cagnall Alley? Yeah.

Well, he played up there with us too. I mean back in the old days. Well, I used to get jobs before that, you know. Well, I used to get jobs and I used to hire him. I ain't the hell not. Did you like his trumpet play? Yeah.
